body.x: Deep In Sight Co., Ltd. (CEO Eunsong Lucas Oh), a leader in AI-based 3D camera solutions, announced its participation in CES 2025, the world’s largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition in Las Vegas, from January 7 to 10.

At CES 2025, Deep In Sight will present its advanced in-vehicle monitoring system, CAMOSYS, alongside the DIMENVUE Pro, a portable 3D spatial information scanner that won the CES 2025 Innovation Award. Building on its success at CES 2024, the company plans to showcase its next-level AI-driven 3D camera solutions, demonstrating advancements achieved over the past year.

Deep In Sight will exhibit at the Eureka Park ZER01NE booth at the Venetian Expo. Attendees will have the opportunity to experience the cutting-edge features of CAMOSYS and the CES-recognized DIMENVUE Pro, which has undergone significant development since its debut last year.

This year’s exhibit demonstrates real-world AI-based 3D camera solutions applications across key sectors, including mobility, smart factories, digital twins, and smart construction. By showcasing these use cases, Deep In Sight aims to highlight the transformative value of its technologies across industries, offering visitors a clear vision of technological innovation.

Deep In Sight intends to use CES 2025 to build business networks with global OEMs and Tier-1 companies while exploring new partnership opportunities to expand its international presence. The company plans to engage in in-depth discussions with potential clients and collaborators, strengthening its foothold in the worldwide market and fostering opportunities for partnerships in Fourth Industrial Revolution-related industries.

Eunsong Lucas Oh, CEO of Deep In Sight, stated, “CES 2025 is a crucial stage for enhancing Deep In Sight’s global capabilities. By combining AI with 3D camera technology, we aim to provide innovative experiences for global clients and solidify our position as a leader in future mobility solutions.”
CES 2025 is expected to be a pivotal event for Deep In Sight as it continues establishing itself as a driving force in the global AI and 3D camera market.
